info.description: FactBase checks factual claims in text or speech against published fact-checks and retrievable web evidence, and returns a sourced verdict per claim. POST /check-text extracts the checkable claims from a text and verifies each; POST /check-claim verifies a single claim; POST /check-audio transcribes an audio clip and verifies the claims it contains. Every verdict is one of supported, refuted, mixed or unverified, carries a confidence note computed from the evidence, a short explanation, and its sources (title, URL, snippet). A claim with no retrievable evidence is reported unverified, never guessed. Every failure is a structured JSON error, including an explicit 503 when the engine is not configured.
info.title: FactBase

post.description: Multipart form-data with one audio file part (mp3, wav, ogg, flac, aac or aiff; 12 MB cap). Transcribes the speech, then runs the /check-text pipeline on the transcript. Returns the transcript plus the per-claim results.

200.description: transcript, claims_found, claims[] (same per-claim shape as /check-claim), note (when no claims found), _meta (includes transcription_engine)

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: invalid_body, missing_parameter, unsupported_format or no_speech_transcribed

post.summary: Transcribe speech and fact-check its claims

post.description: JSON body: claim (required). Retrieves evidence (published fact-checks via the Google Fact Check Tools API when configured, web search, Wikipedia) and returns the claim with its verdict, confidence note, explanation and evidence. If no evidence is retrievable the verdict is unverified by construction.

200.description: claim, verdict (supported | refuted | mixed | unverified), confidence {level, note}, explanation, evidence[] {source, url, snippet, kind}, _meta {service, version, engine, latency_ms}

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter, text_too_long or invalid_body

post.description: JSON body: text (required, up to 8,000 characters), max_claims (optional, default 5, cap 10). Extracts the checkable factual claims (opinions, predictions and questions are excluded) and verifies each through the same pipeline as /check-claim. A text with no checkable claims returns claims_found 0 with an explanatory note.

200.description: claims_found, claims[] (same per-claim shape as /check-claim), note (when no claims found), _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter, text_too_long or invalid_body

post.summary: Extract and fact-check the claims in a text

get.description: Open endpoint (no proxy secret). Returns service status, the reasoning and transcription engine states with the model name, the evidence layer states (Fact Check Tools API, web search, Wikipedia), limits, and recent request outcomes.

200.description: status, service, version, build, engines {reasoning, transcription, evidence}, limits, endpoints, recent_requests, note
